item.title: Vireo selects Nordsol for bio-LNG technology at Lista Biogass
item.description: Nordsol will deliver advanced liquefaction for Vireo as part of expanding bio-LNG production from local organic waste in Norway.

item.title: GULF signs 15-year LNG supply agreement with ENGIE
item.description: Gulf Development Public Company Ltd has signed a long-term LNG sales and purchase agreement with ENGIE designed to reinforce Thailand's energy supply chain.

item.title: CB&I awarded contract by We Energies
item.description: CB&I has been awarded a contract by We Energies to design and build a full-containment LNG storage tank for a peak shaving facility in Wisconsin, the US.

item.title: Petrovietnam Gas awards multi year LNG deal to Shell
item.description: Petrovietnam Gas has signed a five year supply agreement with Shell for 400 000 tpy to be delivered to the Thi Vai terminal from 2027 – 2031.

item.title: Pilot LNG rebrands to Navergy Infrastructure Partners
item.description: As the company expands into new markets and broadens its capabilities across the energy value chain, Pilot LNG has rebranded as Navergy Infrastructure Partners.

item.title: BC Hydro to build additional power line for Woodfibre LNG
item.description: BC Hydro will build an additional power line to ensure Woodfibre LNG has reliable access to clean and renewable power.

item.title: MPA opens applications for additional LNG bunkering licences
item.description: The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore has opened applications for additional licences to supply LNG as a marine fuel in the Port of Singapore.

item.title: Woodside executes JERA winter contract
item.description: Woodside Energy Trading Singapore Pte Ltd has announced the execution of a sale and purchase agreement with JERA Co., Inc. for the supply of 0.2 million tpy of LNG during Japan’s peak winter period for five years.

item.title: KBR expert identifies five trends reshaping oil and gas in 2026
item.description: Paul Bansil, Director of KBR’s international consulting business, has outlined five major trends that will shape how oil and gas operators navigate the year ahead as project developers allocate capital more selectively, face growing regulatory scrutiny, and tackle the challenges of decarbonising existing assets.

item.title: RWE and Glenfarne sign 20-year supply agreement
item.description: RWE Supply & Trading and Texas LNG Brownsville LLC, part of Glenfarne Group, LLC, have signed a 20-year sales and purchase agreement for 1 million tpy of LNG.
